body:
Retained Vulkan rendering exceeds the required frame limits. This branch connects complete retained interval execution to the renderer, repairs CPU endpoint ownership and shared tracing, and binds source, resources and ordered execution evidence to actual products. Progressive viewer callbacks now publish pixels and dimensions as one committed frame, so cancellation and refinement retain a coherent completed image. Governed rendering and full qualification remain unfinished; this PR stays draft.

This draft PR remains at [4bcd987](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/4bcd9875cd9308deabed06a5fa2f17d2321b0cbc). The sole canonical development checkout has progressed separately to [630844e7](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/commit/630844e775a85e74eb5d9ed328a2b8019abb640d) on `development/sanitizer-shader-constant-parser-2026-10-20`; those later source changes are not yet integrated into this PR. The validation below belongs to this PR head and its explicitly identified historical CI products. Current rendering work and its rejected trials are tracked in [#44](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/44). Stock renderer arithmetic and execution remain authoritative. Stage-seven ownership is an explicitly opt-in diagnostic path; its rejected performance result does not authorize renderer adoption. The rejected descriptor cache is withdrawn and absent from this source.

Validation:

- The existing strict GCC qualification preset binds all seven executables, nine products and twenty consumed inputs to this source. The ten original authority controls and six viewer publication controls pass with zero failures/errors/skips. The viewer regression exposed six geometry failures on the prior behavior and passes after atomic frame publication.
- All ten targeted current-source CPU polarisation witnesses pass, including Walker–Penrose conservation, chart agreement, transported disk Stokes and capture-gauge behavior. This finite evidence does not establish the complete scientific estate.
- [Exact-source manual CI38318828623](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38318828623) passes Linux/Windows/macOS integration jobs; its two original native build-only exports independently verify their authority cases and complete product/input bindings. [Fresh PR CI38336123427](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38336123427) also passes all three integration jobs and ten authority cases per platform. All three PR checkouts use GitHub merge commit 2c93415, whose complete source tree equals 4bcd987; this is not a native qualification record for revision 4bcd987. Four full-qualification jobs were deliberately skipped in both runs.
- The actual GCC readiness consumer and unchanged evaluator admit only macos-native-build and windows-native-build: 2/8 domains, six pending, readiness and release readiness false. Complete Mandatory evidence is absent. The tested local Clang producers retain their explicit 0/8 configuration.
- The latest [descriptor reuse trial](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/97#issuecomment-6136527150) is rejected and withdrawn: 11/20 unchanged performance checks and 1/2 API timing checks passed. Earlier rejected numerical and ownership trials retain their exact source and execution bounds; none supplies an accepted rendering speedup.

Preserve all 40 phase fields, four film/pupil columns, seven RHS records, three independent RK trials, four quartics, complete ordered geometry/tangent/projection/dense/interior/event/source/volume joins, refusal/recovery and whole-state rollback. Original references, precision eligibility, scenes, counts, budgets and governors remain authoritative.

[#44](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/44) requires the original software frame within 300 s and usable progressive physical rendering, including disk-free, beam-filtered 100000-star moving ThinLens scenes at 1920×1080 and 5616×4096 on Radeon 780M under 2048 MiB. [#53](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/53) requires final CPU scientific integration. [#48](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/issues/48) requires fresh zero-failure/error/skip Mandatory checks and all eight applicable exact-final domains before main admission. Main remains 5e70607. Unchanged failed frames require an accepted material benefit before another run.

The PR source stays on `development/retained-dense-step-control-2026-10-06`; current development uses the separate branch identified above in the same checkout and existing preset directories. Useful diagnostic source and selected complete raw/binary bundles are pushed on named development/evidence branches with immutable tags; other local evidence remains ignored. Finished scratch is removed after exact recovery and scoped ownership checks. This PR does not claim full rendering, scientific, runtime or release qualification.
